subject.title: Runtime-level model fallback on API call failure

question: Should an explicit user session model selection remain fail-closed, or may it opt into configured cross-model fallback without losing the persisted selection?
rationale: Current shipped behavior deliberately protects explicit model choice, while fallback may change provider, cost, privacy routing, and persisted session semantics; code inspection cannot choose that product contract.

options.title: Add explicit opt-in
options.body: Keep strict behavior as the default and add a narrowly named policy allowing temporary fallback while preserving the user pin.

options.title: Keep selections strict
options.body: Retain the documented behavior and close this request because users must explicitly choose another model when their pinned model fails.

options.title: Enable fallback globally
options.body: Make every explicit selection use configured fallbacks, accepting changed provider-routing and user-intent semantics for existing users.

recommendation.title: Add explicit opt-in
recommendation.body: Keep strict behavior as the default and add a narrowly named policy allowing temporary fallback while preserving the user pin.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available routing signal is the reviewed and merged work defining user-owned versus auto-owned fallback session state.
